question: This title causes an error. Why?
options: Its children are two values, not one string
page must be converted with String()
Only the root component may render <title>
say: This title causes an error. Why?
explanation: Text plus {page} gives <title> two children. It needs a single string: <title>{`Results page ${page}`}</title>. React moves it into <head> for you.
explainSay: The children are two values: the text and page. Build one string with a template literal instead.
